abilities.name: pistol-whip
abilities.description: a short, brutal crack with the revolver's butt when there's no round to spare
abilities._note: M22 B8 ammo-floor (backlog OVERNIGHT §B8). The Hunter base kit had ZERO ammo-free damage, so a dry (0-round) player could deal NO hp at all -> an unrecoverable soft-loss. This is the SURVIVABILITY FLOOR, not a main weapon: a free (cost {}) melee STRIKE the dry hunter can always throw to chip hp. DELIBERATELY weak (dmg 8, poise 12) and short (range 64) so the revolver stays the real gun — it only guarantees a dry player is never fully weaponless. Economy note: base ammo economy runs ~48 supply (12 start + 24 world + ~12 bought) vs ~55-65 demand, and the dodge-reflex re-arm on the mask-drop transform adds a ~6-dodged-round/fight tax; this floor closes that gap without touching supply. TUNING placeholders — dmg 8, poise 12, cast 0.35, cooldown 1.1, range 64.

abilities.name: mark prey
abilities.description: brand a quarry so the next blow opens on exposed nerve — the Provoker's tracking mark
abilities._note: M5 Hunter Seq-8 unlock (direction v2 §6, Provoker). An 'effect'-class tracking mark: a light slow to pin the prey plus a heavy poise_damage opener (the deterministic first-strike bonus §6). TUNING placeholders — poise 30 opener, slow 0.35 magnitude for 2.0s, mid cast/cooldown/range.

abilities.name: incendiary round
abilities.description: a phosphor-cored slug that punches harder and leaves the wound burning — the Pyromaniac's shot
abilities._note: M5 Hunter Seq-7 unlock (direction v2 §6, Pyromaniac). A stronger revolver variant: a projectile with higher instant damage than revolver_shot (26 -> 40) plus a small burn modelled as a direct 'dot' status (no new resolver status default needed — validate_refs stays clean). Costs one round like revolver_shot. TUNING placeholders — dmg 40, burn 4 per 0.5s tick over 3s, cast 0.3, cooldown 3.0.

abilities.name: let the hunt take you
abilities.description: stop fighting it — let the over-ingested potion have its way and become the thing that hunts on all fours
abilities._note: M12 — the SECOND adversary's transform (sable_wren, a Hunter-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL from a bad over-ingestion). A distinct transform from the butcher's assume_form (which hardcodes bieber_monster): this one lands on wren_predator, the feral blood-hunter shape. Fired by wren_human's hp_below reflex, exactly like bram_kell/butcher_human's assume_form seam — the executor's transform code + the self-loop guard handle it unchanged. class:transform, self-target, no cost. TUNING placeholders mirror assume_form's cast_time.

abilities.name: let go the line
abilities.description: drop the harpoon rope, stop pretending the hands are your own — become the thing the harbour dose made
abilities._note: M14 — the THIRD adversary's transform (leland_mack, a Hunter-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL from over-ingesting a Red-Priest potion). A distinct transform from both the butcher's assume_form (bieber_monster) and Wren's shed_the_hunt (wren_predator): this one lands on mack_beast, the feral harbour beast shape. Fired by mack_harbor's hp_below(0.45) reflex — tighter threshold than Wren's 0.5 (HARDER: the player has LESS time in the human-readable phase). class:transform, self-target, no cost, cast_time mirrors assume_form. The executor's transform code + self-loop guard handle it unchanged.

abilities.name: rend
abilities.description: the half-landed avatar sweeps a limb of impossible geometry through everything within reach
abilities._note: M7 Ritual Night — the descended_avatar boss's basic strike. A heavy, wide arc (like cleaver_swipe but harder/longer reach), so a half-manifested outer god (外神) is a real fight, not a bump.

abilities.name: ascend
abilities.description: the half-landed shape gives up its borrowed anatomy and reaches for its truer descent
abilities._note: M7 Ritual Night — the SECOND stage of the two-stage descent (§9). Fired by the descended_avatar's hp_below reflex, exactly like bram_kell/butcher_human's assume_form: at low HP it sheds into descended_avatar_true. A transform, so the executor's assume_form seam handles it and the self-loop guard applies.

abilities.name: star-brand
abilities.description: a hurled brand of starfire that sears its mark — the Hermit's aimed rite
abilities._note: M28 (direction v2 §6, Hermit astrology/ritual). The Hermit BASE-KIT primary + neil_human's opener: a projectile-class star-bolt (reuses the proven ranged/telegraph/dodge path so the tactical brain fires it like a gun) — pure instant damage like revolver_shot (deliberately NO dot: a frequently-cast primary's dot ticks on a living target emit the engine's un-telegraphed 'dot' attack, which would break the §0 telegraphs-precede-all-damage invariant the sims pin). No ammo — a caster spends spirituality, not bullets (spirituality is unenforced today, like paper_charm, so effectively free; the Hermit's real scarcity is a later tuning pass). TUNING placeholders.

abilities.name: ward circle
abilities.description: a chalk-and-starlight circle that snares and wards whoever stands inside it
abilities._note: M28 Hermit BASE-KIT utility zone (mirrors the Hunter's paper_charm). A spell-class point-target zone that slows anyone inside (a warded circle holds its shape against the Gray Fog). Zone status 'slow' has an authored resolver default (NAMED_STATUS_DEFAULTS), so validate_refs stays clean. TUNING placeholders.
